text:
\(F_{A\lor B}=F_A\cup F_B\), \(F_{A\to B}=(X-F_A)\cup F_B\), and clopen sets
are closed under complement, finite intersection and finite union.  (Barwise
prints \(F_{(A\to B)}=F_B-F_A\) \cite[ch.~A.1, \S4, p.~28]{Barwise1977FirstOrder}.
That set consists of the assignments making \(B\) true and \(A\) false; the
assignments with \(\bar v(A\to B)=\mathbf t\) form \((X-F_A)\cup F_B\), the set
used here.  The argument is unaffected, since both sets are clopen.)
